mnemonic.meaning: 映 has 日 (sun): shining in the light. Looking good.
mnemonic.reading: "HAERU!" (はえる) Hi, Ell, you look great.

examples.ja: 夕日に海が映えている。
examples.en: The sea is glowing in the evening sun.

items.note: Slang 映え (ばえ) = looks good on social media: インスタ映え.

mnemonic.meaning: 堀 has 土 (earth): earth dug out to make a moat.
mnemonic.reading: "HORI!" (ほり) From 掘る (to dig).

examples.ja: 城の周りに堀がある。
examples.en: There's a moat around the castle.

items.note: Common in surnames: 堀田, 堀川.

mnemonic.meaning: 粗 coarse + 末 end: coarse to the very end.
mnemonic.reading: "SO, MATSU!" (そまつ) So much for the pine (松) hut: it's shabby.

examples.ja: 食べ物を粗末にしてはいけない。
examples.en: You mustn't waste food.

items.note: 粗末にする = treat carelessly, waste. Polite set phrase: お粗末様でした (after serving food).

mnemonic.meaning: 支 pay out + 給 supply: paying out supplies.
mnemonic.reading: "SHE, KYUU!" (しきゅう) Same sound as 至急 (Level 19).

examples.ja: 社員に制服が支給される。
examples.en: Employees are provided with uniforms.

items.note: Formal: wages, allowances, equipment.

mnemonic.meaning: 眺 has 目 (eye): what your eye takes in.
mnemonic.reading: "NAGAME!" (ながめ) From 眺める (to gaze at).

examples.ja: この部屋は眺めがいい。
examples.en: This room has a nice view.

items.note: 景色 is very close. 眺めのいい = with a good view.

mnemonic.meaning: 器 organ + 官 organ: the body's organs.
mnemonic.reading: "KEE, KAN!" (きかん) Same sound as 機関 (Level 13) and 期間 (period).

examples.ja: 心臓は大切な器官だ。
examples.en: The heart is an important organ.

items.note: Biology. 臓器 (ぞうき) = internal organs.

mnemonic.meaning: 鉄 iron + 道 road: an iron road.
mnemonic.reading: "TETSU, DOU!" (てつどう) The iron road.

examples.ja: この町には鉄道が通っていない。
examples.en: No railway runs through this town.

items.note: 鉄道ファン / 鉄ちゃん = train enthusiast.

mnemonic.meaning: 前 before: before it happens.
mnemonic.reading: "MAE, MOTTE!" (まえもって) Hold it (持って) before (前).

examples.ja: 前もって連絡してください。
examples.en: Please let us know in advance.

items.note: Same as あらかじめ (more formal) and 事前に.

mnemonic.meaning: 脂 has 月 (body part): fat in the body.
mnemonic.reading: "ABURA!" (あぶら) Same sound as 油 (oil).

examples.ja: この肉は脂が多い。
examples.en: This meat is fatty.

items.note: 脂 = animal fat, grease. 油 = liquid oil. 脂肪 (Level 22) = body fat.

mnemonic.meaning: 会 meet + 計 measure: measuring up the totals.
mnemonic.reading: "KAI, KAY!" (かいけい) Kai, okay, the bill please.

examples.ja: すみません、お会計をお願いします。
examples.en: Excuse me, could we have the bill?

items.note: お会計 = paying the bill at a restaurant. Also accounting as a job.

mnemonic.meaning: 資 resources + 源 source: the source of resources.
mnemonic.reading: "SHE, GEN!" (しげん) She finds the general's resources.

examples.ja: 日本は天然資源が少ない。
examples.en: Japan has few natural resources.

items.note: 天然資源 = natural resources. 人的資源 = human resources.

mnemonic.meaning: 換 has 扌 (hand): swapping by hand.
mnemonic.reading: "KAERU!" (かえる) Same sound as 変える (change) and 帰る.

examples.ja: 円をドルに換えた。
examples.en: I changed yen into dollars.

items.note: 換える / 替える = swap one thing for another. 変える = change its state.

mnemonic.meaning: 熱 heat + 中 inside: heat inside. Being absorbed.
mnemonic.reading: "NETCHUU!" (ねっちゅう) Hot inside, absorbed in it.

examples.ja: 子供たちはゲームに熱中している。
examples.en: The children are absorbed in their game.

items.note: 〜に熱中する = be crazy about. 熱中症 = heatstroke.

mnemonic.meaning: 作 crop + 物 thing: things grown.
mnemonic.reading: "SAKU, MOTSU!" (さくもつ) Sack the crops.

examples.ja: 今年は作物がよく育った。
examples.en: The crops grew well this year.

items.note: Farm crops. Read さくぶつ, it means a literary work.

mnemonic.meaning: 手 hand + 品 goods: tricks with the hands.
mnemonic.reading: "TE, JINA!" (てじな) Hand-made gin.

examples.ja: 彼は手品が上手だ。
examples.en: He's good at magic tricks.

items.note: 手品師 = magician. マジック is also common.

mnemonic.meaning: 余 extra + 分 part: an extra part.
mnemonic.reading: "YO, BUN!" (よぶん) Yo, an extra bun.

examples.ja: 余分なお金は持っていない。
examples.en: I don't have any spare money.

items.note: Often "unnecessary": 余分な説明.

mnemonic.meaning: 露 has 雨 (rain) on top: drops like rain on the road.
mnemonic.reading: "TSUYU!" (つゆ) Same sound as 梅雨 (rainy season, Level 24).

examples.ja: 朝、草に露が光っていた。
examples.en: Dew was glistening on the grass in the morning.

items.note: 露 also appears in 露出 (exposure). 露知らず = not knowing at all.

mnemonic.meaning: 行 conduct + 儀 rule: rules of conduct.
mnemonic.reading: "GYOU, GI!" (ぎょうぎ) Note: 行 is ぎょう here.

examples.ja: 子供の行儀が悪い。
examples.en: The child has bad manners.

items.note: 行儀がいい / 悪い = well / badly behaved. Everyday, especially for children.

mnemonic.meaning: 試 test: a test.
mnemonic.reading: "TAMESHI!" (ためし) From 試す (to try).

examples.ja: 試しに一つ食べてみた。
examples.en: I tried one just to see.

items.note: 試しに = as a trial. 試したことがない = never tried.

mnemonic.meaning: 蚊 = 虫 (insect) + 文: an insect that writes on your skin.
mnemonic.reading: "KA!" (か) Ka: the sound of a mosquito.

examples.ja: 蚊に刺された。
examples.en: I got bitten by a mosquito.

items.note: 蚊に刺される = to get a mosquito bite (刺す, sting).

mnemonic.meaning: 組 group + 合 join: groups joining.
mnemonic.reading: "KUMI, AI!" (くみあい) Kumi and Ai join the union.

examples.ja: 労働組合に入った。
examples.en: I joined the labour union.

items.note: 労働組合 = trade union.

mnemonic.meaning: 個 individual, repeated: each individual.
mnemonic.reading: "KO, KO!" (ここ) Same sound as ここ (here).

examples.ja: 個々の問題について話し合う。
examples.en: We'll discuss each problem individually.

items.note: Formal. 一つ一つ / それぞれ are everyday.

mnemonic.meaning: 姓 = 女 (woman) + 生 (birth): the name you're born into.
mnemonic.reading: "SAY!" (せい) Say your family name.

examples.ja: 結婚して姓が変わった。
examples.en: My surname changed when I got married.

items.note: Formal; on forms. 名字 (みょうじ) is everyday.

mnemonic.meaning: 誤 has 言 (words): wrong words.
mnemonic.reading: "AYAMARI!" (あやまり) Same sound as 謝り (apology). Apologise for the mistake.

examples.ja: 計算に誤りがあった。
examples.en: There was an error in the calculation.

items.note: Formal; 間違い is everyday.

mnemonic.meaning: 食 food + 物 thing: things to eat.
mnemonic.reading: "SHOKU, MOTSU!" (しょくもつ) Shocked by the food.

examples.ja: 食物アレルギーがある。
examples.en: I have a food allergy.

items.note: Formal; 食べ物 is everyday. 食物連鎖 = food chain.

mnemonic.meaning: 大 big + 戦 war: a big war.
mnemonic.reading: "TAI, SEN!" (たいせん) A thousand ties broken by war.

examples.ja: 第二次世界大戦は1945年に終わった。
examples.en: The Second World War ended in 1945.

items.note: Mostly 世界大戦 (world war).

mnemonic.meaning: 蒸 has 艹 + 灬 (fire): heat making steam.
mnemonic.reading: "MUSU!" (むす) Moose in a sauna.

examples.ja: 今日は蒸し暑い。
examples.en: It's hot and humid today.

items.note: 蒸し暑い = muggy. 蒸しパン = steamed bun.

mnemonic.meaning: 思 think + 付 attach: a thought attaches to you.
mnemonic.reading: "OMOI, TSUKU!" (おもいつく) A thought (思い) sticks (付く).

examples.ja: いいアイデアを思い付いた。
examples.en: I thought of a good idea.

items.note: Usually 思いつく. 思いつき = a passing idea.

mnemonic.meaning: 通 commute + 学 study: commuting to study.
mnemonic.reading: "TSUU, GAKU!" (つうがく) Two (ツー) school bags on the train.

examples.ja: 毎日電車で通学している。
examples.en: I commute to school by train every day.

items.note: 通勤 = commuting to work.

mnemonic.meaning: 不 not + 可 approve: not approved.
mnemonic.reading: "FOO, KA!" (ふか) Fuka: not allowed.

examples.ja: ペットの持ち込みは不可です。
examples.en: Pets are not allowed.

items.note: On signs and forms. 不可能 = impossible. As a grade: F.
